edge_kinds.composition: to = Σ sign·from (catalogue formula, verified daily on Cube)
edge_kinds.declared_input: to is computed from `from`, role not stated (catalogue depends_on only)
edge_kinds.twin: same quantity on another date basis or grain (concept axes); never both in one causal model
edge_kinds.co_measure: same events counted by another system; a divergence is a data observation, not a cause
edge_kinds.subset: from ⊂ to (part of the same events)
edge_kinds.allocation: to is a model share of `from`, keyed on revenue; never a driver of the same entity's revenue
edge_kinds.mechanism: business prior: a move in `from` drives `to` (direction certain, size for the data to show)
edge_kinds.feedback: lagged reaction of a lever to results (budget / bidding)
